Weakness / Finding: IAM user with AdministratorAccess policy does not have MFA enabled
Raw Evidence: User cloudgoat-admin has AdministratorAccess but MFA is not enabled
Remediation Action: Enable MFA immediately for admin accounts; consider scoping down AdministratorAccess

Weakness / Finding: CloudTrail S3 bucket is publicly accessible
Raw Evidence: S3 bucket cloudgoat-trail-logs used by CloudTrail has public access enabled
Remediation Action: Enable S3 Block Public Access on the CloudTrail log destination bucket

Raw Evidence: Bucket cloudgoat-breach-bucket has S3 Block Public Access disabled
Remediation Action: Enable S3 Block Public Access at both the bucket and account level

Weakness / Finding: IAM console user without MFA enabled
Raw Evidence: User cloudgoat-privesc-user has console access but MFA is not enabled
Remediation Action: Enable MFA for the IAM user via IAM console or CLI: aws iam enable-mfa-device

Weakness / Finding: CloudTrail not enabled in all regions
Raw Evidence: Trail cloudgoat-trail is not a multi-region trail
Remediation Action: Update CloudTrail trail to enable multi-region logging via console or: aws cloudtrail update-trail --is-multi-region-trail

Weakness / Finding: S3 bucket does not have server-side encryption enabled
Raw Evidence: Bucket cloudgoat-breach-bucket does not have server-side encryption configured
Remediation Action: Enable default encryption on the S3 bucket using SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS

Weakness / Finding: S3 bucket does not enforce HTTPS-only access
Raw Evidence: Bucket cloudgoat-breach-bucket does not have a bucket policy enforcing HTTPS
Remediation Action: Add a bucket policy condition requiring aws:SecureTransport = true

Weakness / Finding: EC2 instance does not enforce IMDSv2
Raw Evidence: Instance i-0abc123def456 has IMDSv1 enabled, IMDSv2 is not required
Remediation Action: Set IMDSv2 as required: aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options --http-tokens required

Weakness / Finding: Cognito identity pool allows unauthenticated guest access
Raw Evidence: Identity pool us-east-1:abc123 allows unauthenticated guest access
Remediation Action: Disable unauthenticated access in the Cognito identity pool settings

Weakness / Finding: IAM policy attached directly to user instead of group or role
Raw Evidence: Policy arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/privesc-policy is directly attached to user cloudgoat-privesc-user
Remediation Action: Detach policy from user and attach to an IAM group or role instead

Weakness / Finding: CloudTrail log file validation not enabled
Raw Evidence: Trail cloudgoat-trail does not have log file validation enabled
Remediation Action: Enable log file validation: aws cloudtrail update-trail --enable-log-file-validation

Weakness / Finding: S3 bucket access logging is not enabled
Raw Evidence: Bucket cloudgoat-breach-bucket does not have access logging enabled
Remediation Action: Enable S3 server access logging and direct logs to a dedicated audit bucket

Weakness / Finding: AWS Security Hub is not enabled in this region
Raw Evidence: AWS Security Hub is not enabled in us-east-1
Remediation Action: Enable AWS Security Hub in all active regions: aws securityhub enable-security-hub
